# AppHub
> The curated application store for modern desktop, developer, and creative software.

## Overview
AppHub is a curated directory and distribution platform for independent creators, developers, and power users.
Key features include:
- Curated catalog spanning Productivity, Developer Tools, Utilities, Graphics & Design, Audio & Music, and Games.
- AppHub Gatekeeper security checks and binary integrity verification.
- Direct package downloads (.dmg, .pkg, .zip, .exe).
- Verified community reviews and developer ratings.
- Developer self-service publishing portal.

## Key URLs
- Homepage: /
- Developer Portal: /upload
- Support & FAQ: /support
- User Library: /account
